card.name: Section numbers in label cross-references
card.fires_on: The leading digit of a section number inside a bracketed cross-reference such as [see Dosage and Administration (2.4)] or [see Adverse Reactions (6.1)]. It fires on the digit 2 or 6 just before the decimal point.

modes.label: Dosage section number
modes.description: The digit 2 in a reference to Dosage and Administration subsections.

modes.label: Adverse reactions section number
modes.description: The digit 6 in a reference to Adverse Reactions subsection 6.1.

card.plain: It marks the first number in a label's "see section 2.x" or "see section 6.1" pointer, just before the dot.
